description: This file defines a SigIntWatcher class for handling SIGINT signals, including managing duplicate signals from npm/npx, and a FixedNodeSIGINTHandler class for internal signal handling logic.

classes.name: SigIntWatcher
classes.description: A class to watch for SIGINT signals and provide a promise that resolves upon signal detection.

classes.name: FixedNodeSIGINTHandler
classes.description: A class managing SIGINT signal handlers, including handling duplicate signals from npm/npx.

methods.name: promise
methods.description: Returns a promise that resolves when a SIGINT signal is received.

methods.name: hadSignal
methods.description: Returns a boolean indicating if a SIGINT signal was received.

methods.name: _dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches SIGINT signals to registered handlers, with logic to ignore duplicate signals temporarily.

methods.name: _install
methods.description: Installs the SIGINT handler if not already installed.

methods.name: _uninstall
methods.description: Removes the SIGINT handler if installed.

methods.name: on
methods.description: Registers a handler for SIGINT signals.

methods.name: off
methods.description: Unregisters a handler for SIGINT signals.
